name: Arcturus FieldGuard MK-7 Tactical Uniform
description:
The standard-issue threat-response uniform for Arcturus field operatives, the FieldGuard MK-7 integrates semi-rigid trauma plates within a flexible aramid-graphene weave that hardens on impact and returns to pliability within 0.3 seconds. The deep charcoal shell is treated with Arcturus's proprietary ThermoNull coating, which scatters thermal imaging signatures and resists incendiary splash. Collar and cuff ports allow pass-through routing for standard BCI hardlines without breaking the suit's sealed integrity. Chest and back panels carry embossed Arcturus sigils in matte silver that glow faintly under specific UV spectra — a passive ID protocol used by Arcturus drones in low-light engagement zones.

The MK-7 is cut wide through the shoulder to accommodate standard chrome arm augments and includes an articulated tail gusset at the rear waistband as a baseline geneware accommodation. Operatives on the Shelf know this uniform on sight: it means Arcturus has a contract in the area, and whoever is wearing it has the legal authority to detain, restrain, and in certain sanctioned zones, use lethal force. The uniform itself is not sold commercially — possession without a valid Arcturus employment token embedded in the weave's RFID layer is a restricted-carry offense.
cultural_context: The FieldGuard MK-7 is a symbol of sanctioned authority and, depending on who you ask, sanctioned violence. In Tier 1 and 2 zones, spotting one triggers a specific social response — crowds disperse, dealers pocket inventory, and people find reasons to be elsewhere. For Arcturus operatives themselves, the uniform functions as a kind of armor against the moral weight of the job: you are the uniform, the uniform is the contract.
story_hooks: A decommissioned MK-7 is found stripped of its RFID layer and sold through a Shelf black market — someone is arming civilians to impersonate Arcturus operatives, and the real Arcturus wants to know why.

An operative discovers their suit's ThermoNull coating has been quietly updated to also mask their vitals from Arcturus's own monitoring systems — someone inside the corp doesn't want this squad tracked.
A Tier 2 labor organizer is photographed wearing a partial MK-7 uniform during a strike action, and Arcturus legal is treating it as a declaration of corporate impersonation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian combat silhouette with deliberate menace. Broad-shouldered, fitted through the torso, with reinforced panels that create subtle geometric shadows across the chest and back. The deep charcoal absorbs light, making the wearer appear heavier and more solid than they are. Embossed silver Arcturus sigils catch ambient light like hunting scars. Overall impression: authorized predator.
physical_description.fit: Wide through shoulders and upper chest to accommodate cybernetic augmentation, tapered at the waist, with articulated gusset at rear waistband for baseline geneware. Compression-fitted through the limbs without restricting movement. Collar and cuff ports create subtle architectural breaks in the silhouette.
physical_description.primary_material: Aramid-graphene weave with semi-rigid trauma plate integration. Treated with ThermoNull coating (proprietary Arcturus thermal-scattering technology).
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid appearance in normal light due to ThermoNull treatment, but micro-textured to the touch with faint ribbing where impact plates lie beneath. Embossed sigils are slightly raised and cool to contact.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal (near-black) as primary; matte silver embossed Arcturus sigils on chest and back that shift subtly under UV. Darker shadows pooling in seams and articulation points.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic pressure-seal system along center front, rated for one-handed operation. Friction-fit collar and cuff ports with indexed keying for BCI hardline routing. Rear gusset secured with hidden elastic tensioning.
distinctive_features: Embossed Arcturus sigils on chest and back (UV-reactive, passive drone ID protocol)
Collar and cuff ports for BCI hardline pass-through without breaking sealed integrity
Articulated tail gusset at rear waistband (geneware accommodation)
Wide shoulder cut accommodating standard chrome arm augments
Integrated RFID layer in weave (employment token validation)
ThermoNull coating scatters thermal imaging and resists incendiary splash
Aramid-graphene semi-rigid trauma plates (hardens on impact, returns to flexibility in 0.3s)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working/enforcement class, but signals Tier 1 authority through restricted institutional access. Possession without valid Arcturus employment token is a restricted-carry offense.
physical_description.cultural_context: Arcturus field operative; sanctioned threat-response authority. Wearing this uniform triggers immediate social deference or evasion depending on location tier. For the wearer, it is psychological armor separating operative from accountability — you are the uniform, the uniform is the contract.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or near-pristine when active (weekly maintenance required). ThermoNull coating shows micro-abrasions and minor scorching in high-deployment operatives. Embossed sigils remain sharp; any degradation triggers mandatory uniform replacement per Arcturus protocol.
